# Disagreement Log — GTH_081

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 81
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 81 | "become king" | "reign as king" | "rule" | *mntrro*: to-be-king vs. to-reign vs. to-rule |
| 2 | 81 | "has power" | "possesses power" | "holds power" | Power possession: have vs. possess vs. hold |
| 3 | 81 | "renounce it" | "renounce it" | "give it up" | *bōl ebol*: renounce vs. give up |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "become king" (the literal to-be-king form), "has power," and "renounce it."
